text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen sets the stage for
yet
another fierce Mejiro showdown.
Mejiro
McQueen displays her strength
and comes out
victorious.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The curtains close on the Takarazuka
Kinen with
the cheers of the crowd
praising the two Mejiro
racers for their
valiant efforts.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now that the Takarazuka Kinen is over,
Mejiro
McQueen sets the autumn Tenno
Sho as her new
goal.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And with a dash, she's off to achieve
what no one
in her family has done
before—successive wins in
the Tenno
Sho spring and autumn races.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
